_about: Pix T question dataset (founder, 2026-10-02). Each entry lists ways a visitor might ask something and POINTS AT an answer the site already publishes (a page or FAQ, by path and exact title). It never contains answer text of its own, so Pix T cannot learn to say anything the site does not say. Guardrail rules (price, timelines, off-topic, injection, claims) run before this dataset and always win. Add phrasings freely; run `npm run pix:build` then `npm run pix:test`. The build fails if a target answer does not exist.
